name: aegisvault
description: AegisVault: gestor de contraseñas local-first para navegadores (en desarrollo; no auditado).

scripts.lint: eslint src scripts tests vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings 0
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src scripts tests vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs --fix
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs index.html package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs index.html package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run arch:check && npm run test:architecture && npm run build && npm run verify:build
